prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reported low back pain with muscle tightness and limited range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported pain, and the presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a lumbar strain. No prior injury to the lower back is known from the history provided. Care consisted of eleven visits, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and had regained functional range. Two similar charges recorded on the same day are currently under review for accuracy. Discharge from active care is anticipated, with a return precaution given should symptoms recur or new neurological signs develop.
